result.summary: Found 1 issue: a content problem where a translation key is displayed instead of the actual section title.

issues.description: The section title shows 'home_feed.popular_title' which is a translation/localization key instead of the actual translated text (e.g., 'Popular', 'Popular Near You', etc.)
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization system properly resolves and displays the translated text for this section title. Verify that the translation key is correctly mapped in the language files and that the localization pipeline is functioning.
